REMOVED FROM COURT TRIAL CALENDAR SET FOR DEC-24-2001 - CASE SETTLED ON THE RECORD AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANTS TO VACATE THE PREMISES AT 246 "A" RUTLAND STREET, SAN FRANCISCO, CA, ON OR BEFORE JANUARY 10, 2002, AT 12:00 NOON. PLAINTIFF TO PAY TO DEFENDANTS THE SUM OF $500.00 WITHIN TEN DAYS OF THIS DATE. DEFENDANTS AGREE TO FORFEIT THEIR SECURITY DEPOSIT. PLAINTIFF AGREES TO WAIVE PAST-DUE RENT FOR THE MONTHS OF OCTOBER, NOVEMBER AND DECEMBER, 2001. EACH PARTY SHALL BEAR THEIR OWN ATTORNEY FEES AND COSTS. IF THE DEFENDANTS COMPLY WITH THE FOREGOING AGREEMENT, PLAINTIFF SHALL REQUEST DISMISSAL OF THIS ACTION, WITH PREJUDICE. IF THE DEFENDANTS DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE FOREGOING, DEFENDANTS MAY SEEK ENTRY OF JUDGMENT EX PARTE, UPON 24 HOURS TELEPHONE NOTICE TO DEFENDANTS. SAID JUDGMENT SHALL INCLUDE PAST-DUE RENT, AS NOTED ABOVE, PLUS ATTORNEY FEES AND COSTS, TO THE EXTENT SET FORTH IN THE RENTAL AGREEMENT. IN THIS EVENT, DEFENDANTS SHALL BE CREDITED FOR THEIR SECURITY DEPOSIT. THE COURT RETAINS JURISDICTION TO ENFORCE THIS SETTLEMENT.
DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION OF ALL PARTIES AND ALL CAUSES OF ACTION WITH PREJUDICE
